company.name: Exowatt
company.shortDescription: Exowatt develops modular, dispatchable solar energy systems tailored for high-demand applications such as AI data centers.
company.description: Exowatt develops modular, dispatchable solar energy systems tailored for high-demand applications such as AI data centers. Its flagship product, the Exowatt P3, captures solar energy, stores it as heat in a thermal battery, and converts it into electricity on demand, providing up to 24 hours of continuous power. Exowatt's technology addresses the increasing energy requirements of AI infrastructure by providing a renewable, cost-effective, and reliable power solution. By integrating energy generation and storage into a single modular unit, the company aims to enhance energy efficiency and sustainability in power-intensive industries.

aiResearchSummary.text: Exowatt is researching and developing a thermal storage system with an insulative housing and thermal storage blocks featuring passages for heat medium circulation, as described in Thermal Storage. The company is also working on a grid-balancing solar-thermal system that integrates electric heaters to convert excess electricity into stored heat, as outlined in Load Balanced Solar Thermal System. Additionally, Exowatt explores Fresnel lens panels as solar collectors with self-cleaning coatings, as detailed in Concentrated Heat and Stored Electricity Fresnel Solar Collector. These efforts focus on solar-thermal energy collection, storage, and grid integration.
